name: counterbalanced-skater-squat
instructions:
1. Set up in a single leg stance position with one leg bent behind you and the other supporting your bodyweight while keeping the knee slightly bent.
2. Hold a set of dumbbells out at shoulder height to counterbalance yourself.
3. Descend by flexing the knee of the supporting leg and continue until your back knee touches the ground.
4. Drive through the front foot and extend the knee as you return to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
